source_snapshot.procedure: Qualification: execute 50 PCIe EOM margin loops with a passing EOM per vendor specification.
source_snapshot.criteria: NVQual Test #17 completes all 50 EOM loops without failure.
source_snapshot.script: AI_VR_PCIe_EOM bundle; 60 attended and 2,880 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual and repeated-link risk but lacks the exact topology, vendor margin oracle and lane/iteration evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; held Pending for the pinned tool/config, lane topology, margin limits, aborts and recovery.

old_problem: The proprietary Test #17 artifact, endpoint/root-port/retimer/lane identity, expected generation/width and vendor EOM thresholds/aggregation are absent. The earlier record therefore kept review Pending even though the source clearly defines the fifty-loop qualification objective.
disposition_reason: This is safely expressible as a gate-closed parameterized vendor qualification. The source fixes Test #17, fifty loops and vendor PASS; the missing bundle/configuration, topology and numerical lane oracle are Project Configuration Requirements under ED-02/14/15/19, not reasons for a new review-layer decision. No PASS is possible until every binding is supplied and all fifty independently accounted iterations satisfy the signed vendor rule without a disqualifying link or error event.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2099, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2100 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00022-V002 / 1bb020da69aeb7ad was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
AI_VR_PCIe_EOM and the exact NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Test #17 build/configuration are required packages; no generic command is invented.
Freeze the root port, switch/retimer, endpoint/GPU, lane and expected PCIe generation/width map so every margin result has an immutable physical identity.
The vendor must provide each direction/lane metric, threshold, aggregation and PASS definition; lspci link-up alone is not EOM proof and no threshold may be inferred.
Create an immutable ledger numbered 1 through 50; setup probes, partial runs, missing artifacts or reruns do not count toward coverage.

Each iteration retains raw lane margins and synchronized LTSSM/link/AER/kernel/BMC/thermal/power evidence; stop on the first vendor failure, downtrain/loss, new disqualifying AER, reset, disappearance or safety excursion.
Preserve the first failing iteration and do not continue merely to reach fifty or automatically rerun; use only the approved recovery and engineer disposition.
No NVQual/LTSSM, EOM, link retraining, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized NVQual Test #17 fifty-loop lane-resolved PCIe EOM qualification
test_case.purpose: Qualify the mapped GB-NV-PVP PCIe path by proving every required lane/direction meets the signed vendor EOM margin rule in each of exactly fifty complete Test #17 iterations without link, error or health regression.
required_package: Pinned AI_VR_PCIe_EOM/NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Test #17 package, license, command and immutable configuration
Vendor EOM metrics, numerical limits, aggregation and PASS rule
Expected PCIe generation, width, LTSSM states and exact complete-iteration definition
Dedicated SUT/window, stable power/cooling, console, link/AER/thermal/power aborts and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until all Project Configuration fields are bound. Then preserve topology/link/AER/kernel/BMC/health baselines without clearing them; after point approval run the exact owner-supplied NVQual Test #17 configuration with an iteration ledger of 1..50. For every complete loop retain raw lane/direction margins, tool status and synchronized link/LTSSM/error/health evidence. Stop on the first disqualifying result or evidence gap, preserve it, and do not retry or replace that iteration. After fifty clean complete loops, collect identical topology/link and post-health evidence.
test_case.expected_result: All fifty numbered iterations are complete and uniquely evidenced; every required lane/direction meets the signed vendor EOM criteria, the path remains at its expected generation/width and allowed LTSSM state, no disqualifying new AER/kernel/BMC/reset/thermal/power event occurs, and the mapped endpoint/path remains healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until the tool/configuration, topology and vendor numerical oracle are signed. Thereafter PASS requires exactly 50 complete clean ledger entries and every lane result within limit with stable link/health. FAIL at the first vendor EOM failure, downtrain/loss, new disqualifying error, reset/device loss or recovery failure. Missing package/spec/evidence/approval is BLOCKED and a failed/missing loop cannot be silently rerun into PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact tool, path/lane map, vendor limits, link targets, aborts and recovery are approved.
Use a dedicated service window with stable cooling/power, console recovery and immediate human point authorization.
Preserve all pre-existing PCIe/error evidence and every per-loop artifact; do not clear counters or discard failures.
Stop at first failure, downtrain, new AER, device loss, reset or safety excursion; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact source/variant/hash, tool/bundle versions/hashes/configuration and approval
Immutable path/lane map plus expected generation/width/LTSSM and vendor EOM specification
Ledger 1..50 with complete raw lane/direction margins, timestamps and tool status for each loop
Per-loop synchronized LTSSM/link/AER/kernel/BMC/health correlation and artifact completeness report
Post-test identical topology/link/health or first-failure recovery evidence, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At the first EOM failure, link loss/downtrain, new disqualifying error, reset, device disappearance or thermal/power excursion, stop and preserve the exact iteration. Do not add replacement loops or alter training. Follow only the signed recovery and quarantine the path/SUT if expected topology and health are not restored.

source_conflict.reason: Source method and criterion consistently require fifty vendor-passing EOM loops; absent topology/tool/limits are explicit project inputs, not contradictory requirements.

blocked.reason: Review method and safety/verdict structure are complete; execution can later be BLOCKED if the proprietary artifacts or project oracle are unavailable.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Pinned Test #17 package/configuration, full PCIe/lane topology, vendor EOM limits/pass rule, expected link state, aborts and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; PARAMETERIZED FIFTY-LOOP EOM GATE CLOSED; NO NVQUAL/LTSSM, EOM, LINK RETRAINING, PCIE QUERY, RECOVERY, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: GB-NV-PVP PCIe/NVIDIA qualification owner and authorized platform operator
pending.unlock_condition: Bind and approve every Project Configuration input and point authorization; absence blocks execution/PASS without reopening review unless the source oracle changes.

external_authorities.application: Preserves fifty independent loops and identity while allowing parameterized vendor limits and enforcing direct evidence, stop/recovery and no retry.

project_authority: NVIDIA/PCIe owner supplies tool, topology and EOM oracle; platform owner approves service/safety/recovery; authorized operator releases the run and engineer issues verdict.
